LanguageData.CB_RotateMotorDesc: Turn the motor to face the next adjacent belt.
LanguageData.CB_ConfigureItemsDesc: Open the Port tab to choose which items haulers bring to this port.
LanguageData.CB_NoItemsAllowed: Nothing yet: search below to add items.
LanguageData.CB_SearchHint: Type part of an item name.
LanguageData.CB_SearchMore: {0} more: type more to narrow the list.
LanguageData.CB_WhenFull: When the cell in front is full:
LanguageData.CB_OutputHoldDesc: Keep the item and stop taking more until the front cell has room.
LanguageData.CB_OutputSpillDesc: Put the item on the nearest free cell.
LanguageData.CB_ConfigureOutputDesc: Open the Port tab to choose what happens when the cell in front is full.
LanguageData.CB_PasteModeDesc: Apply the copied full-cell behaviour to this port.
LanguageData.CB_ConfigurePusherDesc: Open the Port tab to see the machine this pusher feeds and choose what happens to items it won't take.
LanguageData.CB_CopyPusherDesc: Copy this pusher's reject mode and eject side.
LanguageData.CB_PastePusherDesc: Apply the copied reject mode and eject side to this pusher.
LanguageData.CB_PusherWhenRejected: When the machine won't take it:
LanguageData.CB_PusherEjectNeverDesc: Throw items the machine never takes to the side. Wait while it is just full.
LanguageData.CB_PusherEjectNowDesc: Throw any item the machine won't take right now to the side.
LanguageData.CB_PusherAlwaysWaitDesc: Hold the item until the machine takes it; the belt backs up.
LanguageData.CB_SelectLineDesc: Select every belt in this belt's line: the straight run in one direction that one motor drives.
LanguageData.CB_ChangeTierDesc: Plan a {0} belt over each selected belt, keeping its direction. The old belt keeps moving items until the new one is built; then it is removed with the usual deconstruction refund, and the items on it stay.
LanguageData.CB_BeingUpgraded: Planned to be replaced by a {0}. Cancel that plan to deconstruct this belt.
